title: Handle rate limit, cap and unknown spend
steps: Show known retry delay and total attempts; keep Stop available.
Inspect the ledger: open, settled and uncertain.
Request a supported allowance revision or end the task.
Reconcile any unknown admission before any replay.
Keep every eligible attempted charge, including failed/cancelled work.
forbidden_fake_states: cap decrease shown as deleting spend
cancelled work omitted from the eligible numerator
complete_when: the final ledger retains every eligible attempted charge, including failed/cancelled work (p.186).
traceability: p.186; controls B-01..B-12, O-06, M-13, K-12; acceptance A30, A31, A32.
